Node Details.swql:
SELECT NodeID, Caption, IP_Address, DNS, SysName, Vendor, MachineType, Status, StatusDescription,
       CPULoad, PercentMemoryUsed, MemoryUsed, MemoryAvailable, ResponseTime, PercentLoss,
       LastSync, NextPoll, IOSVersion, Location, Contact
FROM Orion.Nodes WHERE NodeID = ${node_id}

Active Alerts on This Node.swql:
SELECT aa.AlertActiveID, a.Name AS AlertName, aa.TriggeredMessage, aa.TriggeredDateTime,
       o.EntityCaption, o.EntityDetailsUrl
FROM Orion.AlertActive aa
JOIN Orion.AlertObjects o ON o.AlertObjectID = aa.AlertObjectID
JOIN Orion.AlertConfigurations a ON a.AlertID = o.AlertID
WHERE o.RelatedNodeId = ${node_id}
ORDER BY aa.TriggeredDateTime DESC

Current Percent Utilization of Each Inte.swql:
SELECT InterfaceID, Caption, Name, Status, StatusDescription,
       InPercentUtil, OutPercentUtil, Inbps, Outbps, InErrorsThisHour, OutErrorsThisHour
FROM Orion.NPM.Interfaces
WHERE NodeID = ${node_id}
ORDER BY Caption

Volumes.swql:
SELECT VolumeID, Caption, VolumeType, VolumePercentUsed, VolumeSize, VolumeSpaceUsed, VolumeSpaceAvailable, Status
FROM Orion.Volumes
WHERE NodeID = ${node_id}
ORDER BY VolumePercentUsed DESC

Custom Properties for Nodes.swql:
SELECT NodeID, Caption
FROM Orion.NodesCustomProperties WHERE NodeID = ${node_id}
